description: Stop, pause, sleep or remove yourself (only you). Ops: stop = after this step; pause = hold after this step; sleep = now; rm = off the daemon table now (purge also deletes your stack, no undo). Someone else must bring you back. More: `aos/me.md#/Stopping yourself: self_ctl`.

purge.description: rm only: also delete your stack (no undo)
